title: Ines and the Machine
author: Orsen Brightwater
blurb: Casper Eastwick, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
